pendingCompletion.verificationSummary:
CONTRACT CLAUSE A — `cargo check -p eve-frontend` passes. Run directly: `cargo check -p eve-frontend --offline` → "Finished `dev` profile ... in 0.25s", no diagnostics.

CONTRACT CLAUSE B — the version bump is recorded. Code: `crates/eve-frontend/src/lib.rs:37` is `pub const CONTRACT_VERSION: u32 = 2;`. Documents: `docs/design/frontend-host-v0.md:36` records "`CONTRACT_VERSION: u32 = 2`. Version 2 adds the `tui` frontend kind; the v1 tags are unchanged and frozen"; its compatibility promise at ~line 125 states v2 widens the kind set while leaving every v1 tag byte-for-byte unchanged; `docs/design/compat-matrix-v0.md:22` records `CONTRACT_VERSION = 2`.

AUDIT FINDING 1 — RESOLVED (the blocking defect). `docs/design/compat-matrix-v0.md` recorded the version twice and the bump desynchronized them: line 22 said `CONTRACT_VERSION = 2` while line 85 still read "The frontend contract is already at version 1; its exact-match rule is unchanged." Line 85 now reads "The frontend contract is at version 2; version 2 only widens the set of kinds a hello may declare (adding `tui`), and its exact-match rule is unchanged." Both records now read 2, verified by grep. This was a real contradiction inside a file this change edited, and it contradicted the objective's own clause "where the contract records versions."

AUDIT FINDING 2 — RESOLVED (ui-contrib-v0.md owns `render`'s contract). That document still described two kinds and said the schema test pins "the two frontend-kind tags". All three statements now match the code: the `ModeView::Rows` bullet names `FrontendKind::Tui` as rendering the same rows as `FrontendKind::Rpc` byte for byte because the terminal surface draws real panels, status items and prompt widgets; the headless bullet cites `mode_behavior` for the terminal assertion and for `Null` staying reserved for `Headless`; the compatibility promise says "the three frontend-kind tags".

AUDIT FINDING 3 — RESOLVED (the new arm now has a test, not just compilation). `mode_behavior` in `crates/eve-frontend/tests/contrib.rs` renders `FrontendKind::Tui`, asserts the schema version, destructures `ModeView::Rows` with the message "the terminal surface renders rows, not absence", asserts its rows equal the RPC rows exactly (equality, not a length check, so drift from the mirrored surface also fails), and asserts `Null` stays reserved for `Headless`. TEST HAS TEETH — verified by mutation: temporarily folding `Tui` into the `Null` arm in contrib.rs makes the test fail with `panicked at crates/eve-frontend/tests/contrib.rs:435: the terminal surface renders rows, not absence` and `test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed`. The file was then restored from backup and `git diff --stat crates/eve-frontend/src/contrib.rs` is empty.

OBJECTIVE CONSTRAINTS — all verified. Wire tag: `lib.rs:58-60` are `Self::Rpc => "rpc"`, `Self::Headless => "headless"`, `Self::Tui => "tui"`, with a matching `"tui" => Ok(Self::Tui)` arm in `parse`. The v1 literals are unchanged, so the frozen-tag promise holds. Plugin ABI frozen: `grep -rn "FrontendKind" crates/eve-plugin-api/ crates/eve-plugin-sdk/` returns no matches, and neither crate appears in either commit. The journal `SchemaVersion::V0` is untouched.

AUDIT FINDING 4 (eve-bash) — CONFIRMED PRE-EXISTING AND UNRELATED. The audit reported `crates/eve-bash/tests/sh.rs:884` failing on `count >= 50` because its sandbox exposes 42 environment variables. I read `crates/eve-bash/Cargo.toml` directly: its dependencies are `rustix`, `eve-core`, `eve-plugin-api` and `libc` — no `eve-frontend`. The assertion is about environment-variable passthrough in a shell plugin, unrelated to the frontend contract, and env-dependent by nature. It passed on my subsequent full run (`PASS test`).

GATES: `timeout 3600 bash scripts/verify.sh` → PASS fmt, PASS check, PASS clippy, PASS clippy-build-scripts, PASS test, PASS msrv (6/6). `cargo test -p eve-frontend --offline` → 12 host + 14 contrib, 0 failed, including `mode_behavior` and `every_frontend_kind_tag_parses_back_to_itself`. `git status --porcelain` clean. Commits 52a9844e (the contract change) and 67d95a96 (the audit fixes) on top of db22473e.

Also left `docs/design/reviews/eve20-review.md:7` quoting `CONTRACT_VERSION=1`: it is a dated review snapshot of what was reviewed at the time, not the contract recording its own version, so rewriting it would falsify the review record.
